verses.text: LORD, you’re the God who brings vengeance. God who brings vengeance, shine out!
Rise up, Judge of the earth. Give the proud what they’ve earned.
How long, LORD? How long will the wicked keep winning?
Arrogant words pour out of their mouths. Everyone doing evil brags about it.
They crush your people, LORD. They make life miserable for those who belong to you.
They kill widows and foreigners and murder children who have no father.
They say, “The LORD won’t see it. Jacob’s God won’t even notice.”
Think about it, you people with no sense. When are you going to wise up?
The one who made the ear can hear, can’t he? The one who formed the eye can see, can’t he?
The one who disciplines nations can hold you accountable, can’t he? The one who teaches humanity knows.
The LORD knows what people think. He knows how empty their plans are.
Blessed are the people you discipline, LORD, and teach from your law,
giving them relief in hard times until the pit is dug for the wicked.
The LORD won’t cast off his people or walk away from his inheritance.
Judgment will line up with righteousness again, and everyone with an upright heart will follow it.
Who’ll stand up for me against the wicked? Who’ll take my side against those who do evil?
If the LORD hadn’t helped me, I would’ve gone down to where all is silent.
When I cried, “I’m losing my footing!” your faithful love held me up, LORD.
When worries crowd my mind, your comfort lifts my spirits.
Could a corrupt throne be on your side when it uses the law to cause harm?
They band together against the righteous and sentence innocent people to death.
But the LORD has been my fortress. My God is the rock where I take refuge.
He turns their own wrongdoing back on them. He’ll put an end to them for their evil. The LORD our God will put an end to them.
